name: maintainer-health-triage-eval
description: Acceptance criteria for the maintainer-health agent — one eval per AC line in the PDD.

cases.name: AC-1: healthy-maintainer-no-flags
cases.description: Given a high Scorecard score and recent commits, the agent should report a high health_score and no flags.

evaluators.criterion: The package's health_score is >= 6.0 and the flags array is empty for an actively-maintained, high-Scorecard project.

cases.name: AC-2: stale-maintainer-flagged
cases.description: Given a low Scorecard score and no commits in 18+ months, health_score is low and flags include 'stale'.

evaluators.criterion: The package's flags array contains the string 'stale'. The health_score is <= 4.0 because the project hasn't shipped in 18+ months.

cases.name: AC-3: no-scorecard-data-flagged
cases.description: When OpenSSF Scorecard has no data for the repo, scorecard_score is null and flags include 'no-scorecard'.

evaluators.criterion: The package's flags array contains 'no-scorecard'. The health_score sits in the neutral middle of the 0-10 range (between 3.5 and 6.5) because we lack signal rather than having bad signal.
